title: Build a Complete AI Voice Agent with ElevenLabs: End-to-End Capstone
desc:
The capstone of the ElevenLabs Masterclass: one end-to-end plan for a complete voice agent, built from the official docs. Create the agent in the dashboard or with the Python SDK, write the first message and system prompt, add a knowledge base, connect a webhook tool, put it on a Twilio phone number, add evaluation and data collection, and test it with simulation and tool call tests before launch. Each step points to the episode that covers it in depth.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
